purpose: Design of the eight doc-link SKILLs and two custom Agents: responsibilities, sequences, the operating flow, and the data exchange contract between SKILLs and Agents.
summary: Composition of eight inheriting SKILLs (embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs, resolve-dlid, check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact) and their write permissions
Two custom Agents: toc-updater generates document info, query-worker performs search, with responsibilities and callers
Responsibilities of operation and query SKILLs, each mapped to requirements and design sections
Responsibilities of the four check SKILLs: what each detects and how findings are handled by the project management AI
check-impact result structure: changed documents with direct referrers, recorded content hash versus current hash, no notification state
Use case diagram of users, project management AI and calling skills against the SKILLs
Per-SKILL sequence diagrams (3.1 to 3.8) including the rule for writing references with resolve-dlid
Common operating flow starting from check-dlid, embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs and check-impact, with ordering rationale
Data exchange with custom Agents: identifier values, request and result contents, error values, script validation, deletion timing
tasks: Implementing or modifying any doc-link SKILL.md or its entry script
Implementing or modifying the toc-updater or query-worker custom Agent
Designing the order in which SKILLs are run after document changes
Reviewing which SKILL may write to documents or managed state
Implementing the request and result exchange between SKILLs and Agents
Implementing check-links rewriting of link titles with DLID and content hash
Implementing or testing check-impact change impact detection
title: DES-010 SKILL と Agent の構成
